content.text: I found the cause. `AuthService.resetPassword` never deletes the user's sessions.

candidates.explanation: After the forgot-password hash is verified, the method only sets the new password and calls usersService.update. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. A device that was already signed in keeps a valid session record, so its refresh token still works. AuthService.refreshToken looks up the session by id and hash and issues new tokens. The service already has sessionService.deleteByUserId, but resetPassword doesn't call it.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. Every device is then signed out, and refresh attempts fail.
